speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the consultation. I understand you have a psychiatric condition and have developed new movement symptoms; to begin our assessment, can you describe the specific movements you are experiencing and when they started?

speaker: Patient
text: 23-year-old college student. The patient is here for a follow-up appointment. He was recently diagnosed with schizophrenia and started on risperidone approximately 2 months ago. Reports a significant improvement in psychiatric symptoms since the start of treatment.

speaker: Doctor
text: That is helpful context. Given the risperidone initiation two months ago, did the movement symptoms start shortly after you began the medication, or did they develop gradually over time?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Inability to remain still, persistent feeling of restlessness. I also have Frequent fidgeting, Repetitive crossing and uncrossing of legs, Pacing.

speaker: Doctor
text:
Those symptoms sound like akathisia, a common side effect of risperidone. To confirm this, have you noticed any muscle stiffness, tremors, or changes in your speech while on this medication?

REQUEST TEST: Physical_Exam_Focus_on_Musculature
